name: Default male crew
description: A deck crew member: MPFB2 (MakeHuman) body on the shared game_engine skeleton (53 bones, Unreal mannequin names), CC0 MakeHuman work suit and shoes, an orange life vest, and five keyed animations. Built by blender/build_crew.py; about 34k triangles.

gender.doc: Body shape. 'male' or 'female' (MPFB gender macro at its end points). Pick a suit and hair to match: male_* suits and short hair for male, female_* suits and bob/long hair for female.

height_cm.doc: Barefoot standing height in centimetres. The builder solves MPFB's height slider until the body measures this within 2 cm; shoes add about 1 cm, hair or a helmet more.

weight.doc: Body mass slider, 0 = very slim, 0.5 = average, 1 = heavy.

muscle.doc: Muscle definition slider, 0 = soft, 0.5 = average, 1 = very muscular.

proportions.doc: MPFB body proportions slider, 0 = unusual, 0.5 = average, 1 = idealised. Optional; defaults to 0.5.

age_years.doc: Age in years. Changes face and body shape, and picks the skin texture age band: young under 40, middle-aged 40-59, old 60 and over.

skin.doc: Skin tone: light, medium or dark. Picks a CC0 MakeHuman skin texture (caucasian, asian or african set) and leans the face shape the same way.

hair.doc: Hair style; omit or null for the default (short02 for male, bob02 for female), "none" for bald.

suit.doc: Outfit (CC0 MakeHuman system assets). male_worksuit01 is blue work overalls over a white T-shirt; casualsuits are jeans/shirts; elegantsuit01 is a business suit. null for none (the body is then visible).

shoes.doc: Footwear. shoes01 brown work shoes (default), shoes02-06 other styles. null for barefoot.

hat.doc: Hat, or null. Only fedoras are in the CC0 pack; for a hard hat use the helmet equipment instead (a hat is dropped when a helmet is worn).

suit_color.doc: Optional tint multiplied over the suit texture, [r, g, b] each 0..1 (e.g. [1, 0.45, 0.1] for orange overalls), or null for the suit's own colours.

equipment.doc: Procedural low-poly items, each a mesh Equipment__<name> parented to a bone: life_vest (spine_02, orange by default), helmet (head, white hard hat), binoculars (spine_03, hanging on the chest), radio (pelvis, on the right hip). An entry may also be {"name": "life_vest", "color": "navy"}; colours: orange, navy, yellow, white, red, black, or [r,g,b].

animations.doc: glTF animations, named exactly: idle (3 s breathing and weight-shift loop), walk (1.1 s in-place loop), brace (2.6 s: knees bend, right hand forward-down onto a rail, hold, return), hands_up (2.4 s: raise both hands, hold, lower), squat (2.4 s: down, hold, up). Hand-keyed first drafts; feet stay planted on idle, brace, hands_up and squat.
